delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile delivery methodology characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative approach allows for incremental releases and adaptive scope management, ensuring alignment with client expectations throughout the development lifecycle.

AI tools will assist in drafting documentation, generating code snippets, and automating routine tasks, while human experts will review, integrate, and approve all outputs. This collaboration enhances productivity and quality, maintaining rigorous quality assurance practices and controlled change management to deliver a reliable and effective HRIS solution.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to enhance its human resource management through a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) that streamlines employee data, leave management, attendance, and reporting. This initiative is critical to improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and employee self-service capabilities across the organization.

Exist Software Labs proposes a cloud-deployed microservices solution built on a robust Java/Spring Boot backend with a React frontend and PostgreSQL database. The system will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile methodology, ensuring iterative development with continuous client feedback. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a scalable, secure, and user-friendly HRIS tailored to its specific needs.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution integrates key capabilities including employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and comprehensive reporting. Employees, HR staff, approvers, and management will interact with the system through role-based access, enabling efficient workflows such as leave applications, approvals, document management, and real-time dashboard insights. The solution supports mobile and desktop access, facilitating self-service functions for employees even without company computers.

This approach aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation’s operational requirements by automating routine HR tasks, enhancing data accuracy, and providing timely information for decision-making. The system’s design supports the company’s organizational structure and policies, ensuring compliance and ease of use across all branches.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is architected as a cloud-hosted microservices platform leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL for data persistence. The system includes distinct application layers for user interface, business logic, and data management, with secure APIs facilitating integration with the company’s payroll system and time-recording devices.

Deployment includes separate development, test (UAT), and production environments within a public cloud region acceptable to the client, ensuring scalability to support 300 concurrent users and high availability. Security is enforced through role-based access control, audit trails, and encrypted data storage, meeting the company’s data privacy and compliance requirements.
warranty_support: The warranty period covers defect correction and system performance issues identified post-deployment, ensuring the HRIS operates according to the agreed specifications. Defects can be reported through a defined process, and corrections will be prioritized and addressed promptly within the warranty timeframe.

Issues outside the warranty scope, such as enhancements or new feature requests, will be managed separately as additional support options. This approach provides Kalinaw Trading Corporation with confidence in system stability while allowing flexibility for future growth and improvements.
